Before you start

Getting started

As Admin, you set everything else up: staff logins, doctor schedules, and bulk patient imports. This handbook covers the parts of the Admin panel that are ready to use today. Every screenshot is the real system.

  1. 1Open the hospital system in your browser and go to the address given to you by IT.
  2. 2Type your Username and Password.
  3. 3Click Login. You land on the Admin Dashboard, with its own menu on the left.
⚠Some menu items don't work yet: Appointments, Reports, Billing and Mailbox in the left menu are placeholders — clicking them just returns you to the Dashboard. This isn't a mistake on your part.
👁 What you'll see — the login screen
1

Dashboard overview

Your landing page — a snapshot of the whole hospital.

  1. 1The top cards show new patients, doctors on staff, today's visits, and recent earnings.
  2. 2New Patient List shows the latest registrations — click View All for the full list.
A snapshot of the whole hospital
2

Create a staff account

Create User — every Receptionist, Doctor, Medical Store, and Lab Staff login starts here.

  1. 1Choose the Role first — the form changes depending on what you pick.
  2. 2For a Doctor, also pick their Department and set up at least one shift: tick the Duty Days and set Start/End Time. Click Add Shift for doctors who work more than one block a week.
  3. 3Set a Username and temporary Password — share these with the staff member directly.
  4. 4Click Add User.
A doctor account, with one weekly shift configured
Confirms the account is ready to hand over
💡A new doctor may take a little while to show up in places like Manage Doctor Schedules or the public booking page — the system caches that list for performance.
3

Users list

Users List — every staff login in the system.

  1. 1Search by username or role.
  2. 2Click the pencil icon to edit an account, or the bin icon to remove one.
Every staff account, by role and department
4

Patients list

Patients List — every patient ever registered, hospital-wide.

  1. 1Search by name or Institute ID to find anyone quickly.
The full patient directory
5

Bulk registration

Bulk Registration — register many students or staff at once from a spreadsheet, instead of one at a time.

  1. 1Pick the right tab: Student Bulk Registration or Faculty & Staff Bulk Registration.
  2. 2Click Download Template and fill it in Excel — don't change the column headers.
  3. 3Drag the completed file into the upload box, or click to browse for it.
  4. 4Click Validate & Upload. Rows with an Institute ID that's already registered are skipped automatically.
Download, fill in, upload — duplicates are skipped for you
6

Manage doctor schedules

Manage Schedules — change an existing doctor's weekly duty hours.

  1. 1Pick the doctor from Select Doctor — their current shifts load automatically.
  2. 2Edit the days or times on an existing shift, or click Add Shift for a new one.
  3. 3Click Save Changes.
Read-only view of Dr. Kishore Singh's current shift — no changes were saved here
⚠To just look at everyone's schedule without editing anything, use Visiting Doctor Schedule instead — it's the same read-only view Receptionists see.

Getting help

If a screen looks different from this guide, or something described here doesn't work, contact IT support before continuing. This guide was captured directly from the system on 8 September 2026 using training accounts and a training patient record; nothing here is a real patient's data.
